notes:
Summary: mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted API for 3-week trial, now moving toward Dedicated sizing. Team: CTO (S. Patel) leads infra decisions, Head of ML (A. Gomez) owns model selection, Procurement + Finance involved for 2026 budget window.

Trial performance (hosted):
- Duration: 2026-01-12 -> 2026-02-02 (3 weeks)
- Traffic during trial: sustained QPS ~18, daily peak bursts ~95 QPS (spikes from onboarding flows)
- Observed concurrency: typical 12 concurrent generator sessions, peak 48 concurrent callers during demo load tests
- Token mix: ~68% short-context calls (avg prompt+response ~60 tokens), ~22% medium (200-400 tokens), ~10% long generations (500-1,200 tokens) used mainly for summarization & report generation
- Total tokens ingested in trial: ~1.2M tokens; total output tokens ~2.8M (heavier on downstream summarization tasks)
- Latency: 95th pct for 256-token responses ~145ms on Hosted (acceptable), but 95th pct for long generations bumped to ~780ms; target SLOs: <200ms for interactive flows, <1.5s for report generation

Model & routing preferences:
- Prefer open/quantized models for cost control: Llama2-13B-quant candidate, Mistral-instruct-7B for shortest-latency paths
- Wants automatic routing: low-cost model for non-critical reranking, high-quality model on fallback for tricky queries
- Request: policy-based routing by cost/latency + KV cache for repeated prefixes

Dedicated sizing ask (what we provided):
- Baseline target: 40 QPS sustained across business hours, 150 QPS peak for promos & onboarding spikes
- Concurrency target: sustain 60 concurrent prompt-generations with headroom for 2x burst
- Token budget estimate: 1.5B tokens/month (projection, 6 month horizon) based on growth and feature rollout
- Suggested Dedicated setup: 6x GPU workers (A100-equivalent perf), 2x reserved throughput lanes, autoscale policy for bursts up to 12x when promos run
- Requested: model quantization profile + expected token cost breakdown by model variant (hosted baseline vs dedicated optimized)

Commercial & procurement notes:
- Procurement: "We need line-item pricing for Dedicated (monthly), per-token estimates for mixed model routing, and an overage policy."
- Finance asked for three quotes and for clear migration path from Hosted -> Dedicated without service disruption.
- Price sensitivity: will accept higher monthly commit if unit token cost reduces >=25% vs Hosted trial.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must support SSO/SAML + SCIM for user provisioning in Console.
- KMS: prefer cloud KMS (GCP KMS) but want option for HSM-backed keys; formal security review required before go-live.
- Data residency: logs and audit trail must be stored in NA region for enterprise customers.
